column7: CreateUser's roles.assign checks for the system role and each project assignment (authorizeUserCreationAssignments) returned a refusal error for both a denial and a lookup error, and the caller wrote 403. The lookup error is carried (authorizeLookupRefusal) and mapped with refuseUnlessAuthorized: 503 + Retry-After for an outage, 403 otherwise, no user written. The outage family guard now also recognises a refusal returned as an error (TestAuthorizeOutageGuardCatchesAnUnmappedCheck BadReturned/GoodReturned).
